### useElapsed()

```ts
function useElapsed(startedAt, finishedAt, running): number;
```

A clock that ticks while `running` and holds still otherwise. Times are epoch
milliseconds (`Date.now()`), owned by the caller.

#### Parameters

| Parameter    | Type                    |
| ------------ | ----------------------- |
| `startedAt`  | `number`                |
| `finishedAt` | `number` \| `undefined` |
| `running`    | `boolean`               |

#### Returns

`number`

### ActivityLine()

```ts
function ActivityLine(__namedParameters): Element;
```

One line of agent activity. While running it says what is happening with a live
clock and shows its trace; when done it settles into "Thought for 4.2s" and
folds the trace away, one click from reopening.
